data.narrative:
Breaker Industries is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $6M to date. The valuation analysis relies on two triangulation methods applied against a peer set of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, which span Seed through Series A stages within the Defense & Security sector.

Stage-progression methodology applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage, using the $6M raised as a valuation proxy, implying a $15M valuation. Peer-median analysis examines five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $4.0B (Stark Defence, Series A), yielding a median of $1.0B. The wide peer range ($125M–$4.0B) reflects heterogeneity in founder pedigree, technical capability, and customer traction within frontier-defense verticals.

Triangulation produces a low estimate of $13M, a median of $508M, and a high of $1.1B. The gap between stage-progression and peer-median reflects the substantial variance in early-stage defense company valuations; comparable firms at or near Breaker's stage command valuations spanning two orders of magnitude. Key uncertainties center on customer validation, technical differentiation relative to the peer cohort, and regulatory pathway clarity, which collectively drive the wide valuation range.
